title: The Gnat and the Lion
summary: A bold gnat challenged a mighty lion to battle, buzzing: "I do not fear your claws or fangs!"...
full_text:
A bold gnat challenged a mighty lion to battle, buzzing: "I do not fear your claws or fangs!"

The gnat flew straight into the lion's nostrils, stinging his tender flesh. The frantic lion clawed his own face, tearing his skin until he surrendered in defeat.

Exulting in his victory, the boastful gnat flew off buzzing his triumph, flew straight into a spider's web, and was wrapped in silk and eaten by a tiny spider, proving that pride falls before the humblest trap.
moral: The conqueror of the lion is often brought down by a tiny spider’s web.
